risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial historical operating detail and quantified performance metrics, but COVID-19 creates significant near-term uncertainty regarding store closures, consumer demand, liquidity, and fiscal 2020 results. Management explicitly expects a material adverse impact and has drawn $800 million on its revolving credit facility, while repeatedly acknowledging that the duration and severity of disruption cannot be forecast.
